text:
people-ops: Hey @channel quick onboarding ask — contractors and security onboarding: what do short-term ICs need for laptop encryption, KMS access, and the phishing sim window? Noah (contractor) starts Monday.

noah: hi! i'm the contractor — do i need a corp laptop or can i use my personal mac? also confused about the 1hr security training timing.

it-support-bot: Automated: Please submit your Device Enrollment form: https://intranet/redwood/device-enroll. Contractor device policy requires MDM + disk encryption for network access.

jessica (IT): @noah we prefer issuing a loaner for contractors with assignments >2 weeks. If you use personal, we require MDM + FileVault (mac) or BitLocker (win) + company VPN. Quick steps:
1) Enroll in Jamf (mac) / Intune (win)
2) Enable full-disk encryption
3) Install company certs & VPN profile
If you want us to ship a laptop, reply with shipping address.

samir: FYI my IC last month needed KMS read-only for tests — how do we request key access for contractors?

maria (security): @samir @people-ops KMS access for contractors is limited. We issue short-lived IAM roles (time-bound) and scoped permissions. To request, open a security ticket with: team+reason, target repos/services, duration, and approving manager. Approvals required: eng manager + security. Typical duration: 7–30 days.

noah: can you post the exact ticket template? want to avoid back-and-forth delays.

jessica (IT): Ticket template you can copy/paste:
```
Subject: KMS access request — NOAH (contractor)
Body:
- Person: Noah Nguyen (contractor)
- Role/Repo: inference-eval
- Duration: 14 days
- Justification: running quant tests
- Manager: Samir Patel
```
Attach your ID and expected laptop type.

maria (security): Also: complete the short security training before KMS or infra access is granted. Phishing sim is required for everyone; opt-out is only for exceptional verified cases. Training link: https://learn/redwood/security-newhire

people-ops: jessica — can you ship a loaner if Noah confirms? @noah say "ship" + address if you'd like that.

noah: ship — 123 Maple Ave, Apt 7, San Francisco, CA 94107. thanks!

jessica (IT): Got it :thumbsup: I'll create the device + KMS ticket and ping once shipped. ETA 2 business days.

maria (security): I'll tag the KMS request as CONTRACTOR to fast-track approvals. Reminder: enable 2FA (auth app or YubiKey) and register your device in Okta.

samir: Thanks — I'll be the approving manager. Welcome @noah 🎉

people-ops: Closing loop — we'll check back on day 2 to confirm training and enrollment complete. If anything blocks, DM people-ops or @jessica.
